name: Trip sheet takes focus, makes the page inert, and gives it back

planSteps.description: The trip sheet dialog (data-testid=trip-sheet) is open and the keyboard focus is in its entry date field (data-testid=trip-entry)
The calculator section (id=calculator) is inside an element that has the inert attribute, and the dialog itself is not
The trip sheet is closed, no element on the page has the inert attribute, and the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add) has keyboard focus again
